title: TDS rates of the Income-tax Act, 2025
description: The rate at which tax is deducted under each entry of sections 392 and 393 of the Income-tax Act, 2025, in force from 1 April 2026, one row for each case an entry's rate distinguishes: the rate as printed, its kind (a percentage in the Act, the rates in force of the year's Finance Act, an average rate, a deduction computed under Schedule XI, or the rate of a tax agreement where it is lower) and, where the Act says so, what the rate applies to. Where that is empty, the rate applies to the entire amount of the income or sum (sections 393(1)(a) and 393(3)(a)) or to the amount of the income or sum (section 393(2)). The rates in force themselves are those of the Finance Act of the relevant year (section 2(90)).
